test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the scheme started by the Department of Science and Technology that provides a platform to women scientists and technologists for pursuing research in basic or applied sciences in the frontier areas of science and engineering.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women Scientists Scheme-A (WOS-A)**__.

 
• **Women Scientists Scheme-A (WOS-A)** provides a platform for female scientists and technicians to pursue research in basic or applied sciences in science and engineering frontier areas.
 
• The programme is important for gender mainstreaming since it not only avoids brain drain from the S&T sector but also trains and retains women.
 
• The programme will initially provide opportunities to work as bench scientists and will eventually lead to permanent positions in Science and Technology.​
